narrative.overview:
SmartFarm is a two-surface system: a vivid public world that recruits, and a calm operational world that runs the farm. The public surface is bright, energetic agri-tech — Signal Red action against light-gray whitespace, bold confident copy, and feature cards that feel modern and approachable. The operational surface — the Filament dashboard and generated PDF documents — is serene and precise: Pasture Green primary actions, quiet grays, and money that is always legible at a glance.

The personality is fresh, modern, and lean: generous whitespace, rounded corners, and a single modern grotesque typeface (Figtree) that carries the whole system without a display contrast pairing. Components are refined and restrained — hairline borders, soft layered shadows, and quiet neutrals — so that only genuine primary actions ever wear brand color. The two accents never compete: Signal Red is locked to public/auth screens, Pasture Green to operations. The shift from red to green is the product story: *we get your attention; then we give you order.*
keyCharacteristics: Two-surface color contract: Signal Red for public persuasion, Pasture Green for operations and money.
Fresh agri-tech atmosphere: bright accents, generous whitespace, rounded corners, approachable copy.
Refined and restrained components: hairline borders, soft layered shadows, quiet grays.
Money is always green ink (income, net positive) or red ink (expenses, losses), prefixed "KSh".
Micro-labels are uppercase with wide tracking on table headers and PDF documents.
Figtree alone; no display-contrast type pairing.

rules.name: The Two-Surface Rule
rules.body: Signal Red and Pasture Green are surface-locked. Public/auth screens lead with red on light gray; the dashboard and PDFs lead with green. Never blend both brand accents on one screen.

rules.name: The Green-Ink Rule
rules.body: Positive money (income, net income, yields) is Pasture Green; negative money (expenses, losses) is danger #dc2626. Currency is always "KSh".

rules.name: The Quiet-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Neutrals stay in the gray-50→gray-900 / slate family. Muted text is #6b7280; secondary actions are white with a gray-200 border. A screen's calm is the point.

rules.name: The Uppercase Micro-Label Rule
rules.body: Column headers, PDF field labels, and kickers are uppercase, 0.72rem (PDF 9px), weight 500–600, letter-spacing 0.05em or wider. Never apply this treatment to body copy.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows only separate top-level surfaces (stat cards, sections, forms). In dark mode shadows are dropped and surfaces separate by borders alone. Never stack heavy or colored shadows.

dos: Do keep public pages on the light-gray ground with Signal Red as the only brand accent.
Do use Pasture Green for every dashboard primary action, active nav state, and positive money figure.
Do lead tables and PDF labels with uppercase micro-labels (0.72rem, 0.05em+ tracking).
Do apply the softly layered shadow set verbatim (stat-card / section / form-card values).
Do reference the frontmatter tokens when adding a color, radius, or padding to new screens.
donts: Don't mix Signal Red and Pasture Green on the same screen.
Don't add new brand accents or gradient fills (the auth hero overlay is the single exception).
Don't stack heavy or colored shadows; in dark mode drop shadows entirely and separate by borders.
Don't draw money in any color other than Pasture Green (positive) or #dc2626 (negative).
Don't introduce a display-contrast type pairing; Figtree alone is the stack.
Don't add emojis to the UI or to generated documents.
